name: product-rebuild
description: Rebuild an existing product end-to-end to learn the full product development lifecycle. An orchestrator over rspec (the spec, verified against the running reference), sdlc (each slice's build lanes) and bug-hunter (defect search): gates lock rspec's artifacts, hidden tests stay out of the lanes, each slice boundary runs G6 cheapest first and routes every finding, and the pipeline finishes at a verified production-readiness gate.
